Intent to create, edit, move, or remove a DIP. Add extra 'point' to edit. Add extra 'command' with value of 1 to move the DIP. Add extra 'command' with value of 0 to delete the DIP. Add extra 'newDIP' with value true to create a new DIP.

Intent to move a DIP, this will enure the user does not accidentally move a DIP by showing a confirmation dialog. Needs extra 'uid', being the UID of the DIP and a 'point' being the string value of the GeoPoint to move the DIP to.
Intent to plan out a DIP. Requires extra 'uid' to be the UID of the DIP to plan the jump for.
Intent to reload the list of available wind servers.
Intent to share a DIP. Requires extra 'uid' to be the UID of the DIP to share.

Intent to hide or show the the forward throw arrow. Requires the 'uid' of the last out point to show the forward throw arrow it should be attached to. Also requires 'forwardThrow' to be the value in meters of the forward throw.
Intent to begin the process of placing an alternate DIP. Requires 'uid' which is the UID of the primary DIP to associate the Alt DIP with.
Intent to toggle the labels on the AC Course Box on and off
Intent to show the compass ring around the DIP. Requires extra 'dipBearing' to be true to show the compass circle. Requires 'uid' which is the UID of the DIP.

Intent to show a distance circles around a HARP. Requires 'uid' which is the UID of the HARP. Requires 'point' which is the location of the HARP. Extra 'acType' can be 'high performance' or 'low performance' to set the initial ring distance. If not specified default to high
Intent to show an overlay that shows where the jumpers should meet up.

Intent to show, hide or edit a landing pattern. Requires 'uid' which is the UID of either the DIP or an existing landing pattern point. If the UID is a LP point then show the edit LP view. If the UID is of a DIP, hide or show the LP, depending on if it's already visible or not.
Intent to show a circle around a HARP. Requires 'uid' which is the UID of the HARP. Requires 'point' which is the location of the HARP. If extra 'simple' is true, just showe a basic circle.
